start.text: Routes plotted. Try not to invalidate them.
I see a path. Following it in.
Stay close. The battlefield has currents too.

start_boss.text: That's large. Its blind arcs aren't.
There is a route through this. Give me a moment.

retreat.text: I've found a quieter current. Following it out.

out_of_missiles.text: No more missiles. Adjusting the route.

need_help.text: The route is closing. I need an opening.

hull_50.text: I need room to alter course.

hull_30.text: This route ends badly. Cover me.
I can still get us out. Barely.

overload.text: Flux locked. Give me a moment.

victory.text: Exactly where I expected them to break.

victory_boss.text: Even that had a way through.
